function.name: update_raw_availability
function.description: Appends a short note of what the caller just said about their availability to the running log for this request (e.g. 'Tuesday afternoon'). Does not replace prior notes — call this every time the caller says something new about availability, including corrections or rejections of an offered slot.

requestID.description: The id returned by get_new_requestID for this service request

raw_text.description: What the caller just said about their availability
